referenceTitle: Single-particle ICP-MS characterisation of cadmium nanoparticle forms in mussels
reason: Identifier mismatch: no unique Bao 2024 cadmium-nanoparticle mussel study was identified. The explicitly linked HMI anchor gives DOI 10.1093/jaoacint/qsae024, whose primary full text is a different article by Bruvold, Valdersnes, Loeschner and Bienfait on gold nanoparticle method validation. Do not publish that unrelated paper under the claimed Bao/cadmium title.

attempts.note: Read Bao anchor and explicit DOI destination. HMI labels it cadmium nanoparticle characterization, but its cited identifier contradicts that description.

Read primary full text, metadata, abstract, sample preparation, validation design and conclusion. Actual title: Validation of a Method for Surveillance of Nanoparticles in Mussels Using Single-Particle Inductively Coupled Plasma-Mass Spectrometry; Journal of AOAC International 107(4):608–616 (2024). Gold spikes and Ti/Cr/Cu demonstrations, not Cd. It cannot verify no-excretion, lifelong accumulation or sediment-porewater claims.
